notes.title: Demo Overhaul & Fusions
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]First off, a HUGE thank you to all of you who’ve been playing, reviewing, and sharing the game with your friends. Your support means the world to me, and I love seeing the community grow. Your feedback has been amazing, and I am doing everything I can to keep improving and adding exciting new content.[/p][p][b]Content Creator Coverage[/b][/p][p]I've been lucky enough to see some fantastic content creator coverage recently! Check out these awesome videos from all over the world to see how others are diving into Hand of Hexes.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][/p][/th][th][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jwOnCTS3LJc&pp=ygUNaGFuZCBvZiBoZXhlcw%3D%3D"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rzoHBZF9Irk"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H6EfJ8MMJ0s"][/dynamiclink][/p][/td][td][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5QjHDUNVtyo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PdAwhJpVoqk"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VVfHvLe7tiI"][/dynamiclink][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b]Big New Feature – Fusions![/b]
I’ve got something [i]big[/i] for you in this update: [b]Fusions[/b]! Now, you can visit special event nodes where you can fuse the behaviors of two towers. This means double the firepower, double the effects, and a whole new layer of strategy for you to explore. Mix and match to create unstoppable tower combinations and watch the chaos unfold![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45571637/7f03b46662d9b1bb6ef6c10a169db73936db5ee8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Tower: The Explosive Chicken[/b]
Get ready for the latest tower, the [b]Chicken[/b]! This feathery friend doesn’t just lay eggs… they lay [b]explosive eggs[/b]! The more eggs they lay, the bigger the boom. A perfect addition to any tower defense setup![/p][p][b]New Maps[/b]
I’ve also added [b]new maps[/b] to keep things fresh and exciting. Each one has its own unique challenges, so you’ll need to bring your A-game to tackle them.[/p][p][b]Stay Tuned for More[/b]
There’s a lot more to come, and I am just getting started. Stay tuned for future updates, and I can’t wait to show you what’s next![/p][p]Thanks again for all the support, couldn’t do this without you![/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]emmdieh[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo release NOW
notes.content: [p]Thank you to the organizers of debut festival for letting me end the festival on a bang: The Hand of Hexes demo is out now! Featuring a reduced set of characters, maps, levels and acts from the final game, I hope you have a great time and let me know what you think! Updates will be rolled out in the coming days[/p]

notes.title: Demo soon and merchant update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Development has been pretty smooth and steady. I managed to knock out some key features, such as visual indicators for tower placement, a merchant event and a lot of visual pizzaz. So things are looking pretty good for a demo release later in the month!  There are various other minor things I would like to include, like a save system besides the basic one I have for settings etc. so far. [/p][p]At the moment, there are only about 17 playable cards and towers, so I would like to also crank that number up until release. If you have any thoughts about a quantity for the demo, let me know! [/p][p]Have a nice day, [/p][p]Emmanuel[/p]

notes.title: Steam page launch and what's next
notes.content:
[h1]Steam page launch[/h1]
A huge thank you for all the support so far! Hand of Hexes is currently sitting at about 500 wishlists, even before the release of the demo. This would not have been possible without everyones help, telling your friends and pressing that wishlist button. 
[h1]What's next?[/h1]
[h2]Demo[/h2]
Right now, the next big step for Hand of Hexes is going to be a demo release. At this point, about ten spells and towers are fully funtional and release ready, a minimum for the demo would be arround 40. So stay tuned while the content machine turns! The amount and functionality of biomes is also not yet set in stone, with three implemented biomes so far.
